_comment: WARROOM-CONTROL-001 Phase 1 — dispatchable-job inventory only. NOT a dispatch manifest yet: every destructive value is the literal string UNSET per the card's own hard rule (Claude Code must not seed values, not even provisionally). Also NOT authoritative on auth model — see _phase1_findings below for a major pre-existing-implementation finding that changes this card's scope.

_phase1_findings.surface_is_not_a_void: CORRECTION to the card's own WHY section: the Run buttons do NOT currently 'post into the void.' A real dispatch path already exists: warroom-v5.html's runAgent()/viewLogs() -> POST /api/command?path=/jarvis/run/<name> (Vercel proxy, api/command.js) -> https://api.sasmaster.dev/jarvis/run/:name (command-api/src/railway.ts, WARROOM-JARVIS-RUN-001, shipped 2026-08-22, predates this session). This is a real, already-deployed, already-auth-gated control plane — this card is a CONFORMANCE/HARDENING pass against an existing system, not a from-scratch build.
_phase1_findings.existing_auth_model: api/command.js already implements decision-gate option (a) from the card's own text: a single shared-secret Bearer token (WARROOM_CLIENT_TOKEN, Vercel env var, never exposed to the browser bundle — confirmed by reading the file, the client only ever sends whatever the operator manually puts in localStorage['wr-api-token']). Unauthenticated/wrong-token POST to a mutating path returns 401 (confirmed by reading api/command.js's isMutating check). This satisfies the letter of 'no default principal, no credential in client source' but the card explicitly reserves the AUTH MODEL CHOICE to Shiv as an open gate — this existing implementation predates the card and was never run through that gate. Flagging for Shiv: is this existing shared-secret model the ruled answer, or does it need to be revisited?
existing_dispatch_gaps_vs_card_contract: No run_id / no sasmaster.ops.run_log row. /jarvis/run/:name returns {job_id, status:'pending', poll:'/api/jobs/:id'} and writes to a completely separate S3-backed queue (jobs/queue.json), NOT sasmaster.ops.run_log. This fails C3/C6 as written: OPS/AGENTS/DATA/QUEUE cannot resolve a manual dispatch to the same run-log row a cron run of the same job produces.
No concurrency guard — nothing prevents firing the same job twice within its non-terminal window.
No destructive-classification gate — every JARVIS_RUNNABLE entry fires immediately on POST, no confirmation dialog server-side.

/jarvis/command (the OPS command-bar '/ fire <job>' handler) is a real, deployed 501 stub — 'JARVIS command console has no backend dispatcher yet'. The command bar UI element exists and is wired client-side but every use of it currently 501s.

CANVAS re-run (canvasRerun()/canvasRerunDate() -> /jarvis/run/daily-visuals) also 501s — 'daily-visuals' is explicitly commented out of JARVIS_RUNNABLE, no generator pipeline exists yet per railway.ts's own comment.

surface_counts.N_run: 1 primary Run button per agent card (2 DOM sites render it: the compact card at line ~2179 and the drill-down detail panel at line ~1420) + 2 CANVAS re-run buttons (daily + per-date), all funnelling through runAgent()/canvasRerun()/canvasRerunDate()
surface_counts.N_logs: 1 Logs button per agent card (2 DOM sites, same pattern as Run) — opens a new tab to /logs?agent=<name>, does not tail inline (card's §3.2 spec wants inline tail with data-state, this just window.open()s a raw log endpoint)
surface_counts.N_verbs: 1 OPS command-bar input (#v-ops .cmd input) — free-text '/fire <job>' syntax, forwards raw string to the 501-stubbed /jarvis/command
surface_counts.agent_card_count_live: 51 total fleet (generate-status.js agents_total), but only 11 have a real backend dispatch target in JARVIS_RUNNABLE — the other ~40 agent cards' Run buttons will 501 with 'no runnable job named X' if pressed. This is itself a real, currently-live UX defect: 40 buttons that fail every time, not disclosed to the operator until pressed.

Railway Monitor.note: railway.ts's own comment: NOT inert during a real outage — its circuit-breaker can trigger a real Railway redeploy if the monitored service is down at trigger time. Flag for Shiv's destructive-classification pass specifically.

daily-visuals (CANVAS).exec: NOT BUILT — no generator pipeline exists
daily-visuals (CANVAS).note: Button exists and is wired client-side, backend deliberately 501s per railway.ts's own comment. Not a dispatchable job today.

ops-command-bar (all free-text /fire ver.note: /jarvis/command is a real, deployed 501 stub. Every use of the command bar currently fails.

remaining_~40_agent_cards.note: Every Run button on these ~40 cards currently 501s if pressed. Real, live UX defect — the button looks identical to the 11 working ones with no visual distinction.
